name: Kelp Tender
prompt: One full-body FRONT orthographic eye-level monster master for Elyndra, beautifully hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG creature. Kelp Tender: a tall swaying figure of braided kelp with a bulb head glowing soft green, frond arms trailing; small oysters clinging to its stalk. Tall slender organic kelp being, long braided olive and deep teal seaweed stalk forms torso, a translucent oval kelp bulb head with contained soft green bioluminescence, no human face. Exactly two graceful long frond arms dangling outward, ribbon seaweed tips, compact split root holdfast feet below. Several small ridged oyster shells visibly attached to central stalk. Natural elegant neutral gently swaying pose with entire body square to camera. Rich warm painterly texture, clear overlapping braids and fronds, readable silhouette, soft dimensional shading. Entire bulb, arms, frond tips and root base inside square canvas with generous transparent margin. No ocean water, bubbles, rocks, floor, cast shadow, background glow, text or other creatures. Internal head glow only, transparent background.
